decisions.answer: Approve only the corrected €74,000-profit accounts, subject to explicit disclosure of the €9,000 inventory sensitivity and missing insurance evidence.
evidence: 01 USE THIS NUMBERS FINAL v9.xlsx, Management P&L
decisions.aiProposal: Approve the corrected accounts, not management's unreconciled version.
decisions.independentChallenge: Independent review agrees accounts must be corrected before valuation but prefers the €65,000 profit case because it relies on the stated consumption record.
decisions.studentReasoning: The corrected statements reconcile and remove unsupported revenue, income and personal expenses. The inventory conflict remains material enough to disclose before valuation.

decisions.question: Freeze owner-card access
decisions.answer: Yes. Freeze owner-card access immediately and require documented business purpose and approval for all future spending.
evidence: 09 Loans Owner Card and Legal Problems.pdf, pp. 1-2
10 Email and WhatsApp Dump DO NOT FORWARD.pdf, pp. 1-3

decisions.question: Move September deposits to contract liabilities
decisions.answer: Yes. Move the full €90,000 September receipts to contract liabilities until delivery.
evidence: 04 Contracts Returns and Angry Customers.pdf, pp. 1-2

decisions.question: Begin weekly 13-week cash forecast
decisions.answer: Yes. Begin a weekly 13-week cash forecast; closing cash is only €60,000 against significant current liabilities.

decisions.question: Stop credit sales to insolvent/high-risk customers
decisions.answer: Yes. Stop new credit sales to insolvent or high-risk customers pending credit approval and collection controls.
evidence: 04 Contracts Returns and Angry Customers.pdf, pp. 1-2

decisions.question: Dispose of damaged stock
decisions.answer: Yes. Segregate and dispose of the damaged stock; retain the €2,000 disposal quote for cash planning and approval.

decisions.question: Investigate management override and duplicate sources
decisions.answer: Yes. Investigate management override, duplicate source files and unsupported reclassifications; preserve the audit trail.
evidence: 01 USE THIS NUMBERS FINAL v9.xlsx, Management P&L
10 Email and WhatsApp Dump DO NOT FORWARD.pdf, pp. 1-3

decisions.question: Renegotiate supplier terms
decisions.answer: Yes. Renegotiate supplier terms and reconcile opening/current allocations, especially the Event supplier payment.
evidence: 06 Purchases Invoices and Goods Received.pdf, pp. 1-2

decisions.question: Continue core Finally Single and event operations
decisions.answer: Yes, continue the core Finally Single and event operations with tightened credit, inventory and cash controls; reassess Never Call Back customer quality.
evidence: 03 CRM Export Cleaned FINAL.xlsx, CRM Export
04 Contracts Returns and Angry Customers.pdf, pp. 1-2

decisions.question: Use claimed management profit for earn-out
decisions.answer: No. Do not use management's €312,000 profit for the earn-out; use corrected profit of €74,000, with €65,000 shown as the inventory sensitivity.
evidence: 01 USE THIS NUMBERS FINAL v9.xlsx, Management P&L
decisions.aiProposal: Reject the management profit because it includes future revenue and borrowing income and omits material adjustments.
decisions.independentChallenge: Independent review also rejects €312,000 but supports a lower €65,000 corrected profit based on the explicit €405,000 consumption record.
decisions.studentReasoning: Management profit is overstated by €238,000 in the selected case and was produced under documented pressure. Valuation must use reconciled accounts and the disclosed sensitivity.

boardRecommendation.decision: Do not use management's €312,000 profit for the earn-out.
boardRecommendation.valuationBasis: Use corrected net profit of €74,000 and present €65,000 as the inventory-record sensitivity until the €9,000 conflict is resolved.
boardRecommendation.continueOperations: Continue Finally Single and event operations with stronger controls; review Never Call Back credit quality.
